meaning:
Someone descended from Pelath(?), first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18
§ Pelethites = "couriers"
1) a collective name for the guardsmen of David
1a) probably descendants of an unknown person, perhaps Philistine mercenaries

elsewhere.note: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and David’s sons were chief ministers.
So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on king David’s…
and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.
